prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs.
Required API: pub fn canonical_path(base: &str, segments: &[&str]) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Join a base absolute slash path and relative path segments. Ignore empty and dot segments, resolve dot-dot without escaping root, collapse repeated slashes, and return null/None/error marker for a non-absolute base or an attempted root escape. The root result is '/'.
Visible example: base /a/b with segments ../c, ./d becomes /a/c/d; base / with .. is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs.
Required API: pub fn canonical_path(base: &str, segments: &[&str]) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Join a base absolute slash path and relative path segments. Ignore empty and dot segments, resolve dot-dot without escaping root, collapse repeated slashes, and return null/None/error marker for a non-absolute base or an attempted root escape. The root result is '/'.
Visible example: base /a/b with segments ../c, ./d becomes /a/c/d; base / with .. is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: pub fn canonical_path(b:&str,s:&[&str])->Option<String>{if !b.starts_with('/'){return None}let mut p=Vec::new();for r in std::iter::once(&b).chain(s.iter()){for x in r.split('/'){if x.is_empty()||x=="."{continue}if x==".."{p.pop()?;}else{p.push(x)}}}Some(format!("/{}",p.join("/")))}
